title: The Hidden Power Struggle Between Lions and Hyenas - Nautilus
gist: A new Frontiers in Ethology study of large carnivores in Namibia and Botswana overturns the long-standing assumption that hyenas merely scavenge lion kills, finding instead that lions actively pursue hyenas.

themes.theme: Role reversal in the lion–hyena relationship

insights.claim: A new study of large carnivores in Namibia and Botswana published in Frontiers in Ethology finds that lions actively pursue hyenas, rather than hyenas simply skulking around lions for scraps.
insights.so_what: Interspecific competition models used in predator conservation planning may have the dominance direction backwards, changing how reserves manage carnivore density.
insights.quote: highlights a totally different dynamic—one in which lions are actively pursuing hyenas
insights.locator: But a new study of large carnivores
insights.speaker: Devin Reese

themes.theme: Cultural priors embedded in field science

insights.claim: The scientific default that hyenas steal leftover scraps from lion kills tracks the popular depiction in The Lion King, illustrating how cultural narratives harden into research assumptions.
insights.so_what: Where an unexamined popular story matches the scientific consensus, the consensus is unusually likely to be untested — a general place to look for mispriced beliefs.
insights.quote: the assumption has always been that hyenas skulk around lions to steal the leftover scraps from their kills, just like the spotted hyenas in The Lion King
insights.locator: Scientists know that lions and hyenas are found together
insights.speaker: Devin Reese

insights.claim: Co-occurrence of lions and hyenas in the African veld was long established, but the behavioral mechanism linking them had been assumed rather than measured until this study.
insights.so_what: Observed correlation with an untested causal story is exactly the pattern that later reverses — a template for auditing accepted explanations.
insights.locator: Scientists know that lions and hyenas are found together in the African veld
insights.speaker: Devin Reese
